title: Smithfield budget board drafts new fiscal 2028 reporting rules
text:
← Back to the wire
Government
Smithfield budget board drafts new fiscal 2028 reporting rules
The board discussed capping department slide presentations at 22 slides and 30 minutes under a proposed standard operating procedure.
The Smithfield Financial Budget and Financial Review Board on Tuesday, Oct. 13, 2026, worked through a draft set of guidelines governing how town departments must prepare and submit budget materials for the fiscal 2028 review cycle.
THE PROPOSAL The board chair told members the document, divided into 11 sections, built on a bullet list previously prepared by a member identified as Ken. "I took his bullet list and quite frankly copy and pasted quite a bit of it," the chair said, adding further sections and edits before opening the floor for feedback section by section.
REPORTS AND SLIDES Under the draft, departments would have to submit a formal written report supporting their presentation, and the chair said the report should arrive before the presentation itself, not alongside it. "A report should be delivered prior to prior to the presentation," the chair said. Slide presentations would be capped, with the board agreeing slides "may not exceed 22 slides, may not exceed 30 minutes" and must support rather than duplicate the written report.
DATA REQUIREMENTS The draft requires that any change to an individual account, increase or decrease, include both subjective narrative and objective data, and that staffing increases include objective data such as workload indicators.
